package.description: An easy to use tool that creates optimal cutting plans and accurate costings that you can have confidence in. Input panel sizes and materials, MaxCut does the rest…

en-US.description: An easy to use tool that creates optimal cutting plans and accurate costings that you can have confidence in. Input panel sizes and materials, MaxCut does the rest…
en-US.longDescription:
MaxCut is designed for your growing cabinetry business. An easy to use cutlist optimizer that creates optimal cutting plans and accurate costings that you can have confidence in.
- Save a fortune on materials! Cut the sheet to its full potential. Avoid costly saw operator mistakes. No more expensive offcuts lying around your workshop or in the bin.
- Accurate quotations. Generate cabinetry quotations quickly, accurately and efficiently, knowing you have the right price and the correct number of sheets for the job every time.
- All the reports you need. Print to email cut lists, supplier order lists, cabinet labels, professional quotes and more with no extra effort.
en-US.name: MaxCut

zh-CN.description: 一款简单易用的工具，可生成最优切割方案与精准成本核算，让您无后顾之忧。只需输入板材尺寸与材质参数，MaxCut 将为您完成余下工作……
zh-CN.longDescription:
MaxCut 专为蓬勃发展的橱柜业务量身打造。这款易于使用的裁切清单优化工具，能生成最优切割方案与精准成本核算，让您全程无忧。
- 大幅节省材料成本！充分释放板材价值，杜绝因锯切操作失误造成的浪费，从此告别车间或废料箱中堆积如山的昂贵边角料。
- 精准报价系统：快速生成精确高效的橱柜报价单，每次都能确保用材数量与成本核算分毫不差。
- 一站式报表输出：轻松打印或邮件发送裁切清单、供应商订单、柜体标签及专业报价单等全套文件，高效无负担。
